title: Production capability and public surface controls
goal: Expose only launch-certified capabilities and public routes while publishing correct production security, crawler, and release metadata

in: Canonical enabled, pilot, and disabled capability manifest
Navigation, page, API, cron, worker, debug-route, header, CSP, canonical, sitemap, robots, and staging noindex controls

acceptance_criteria: Disabled capabilities are inaccessible through UI, direct routes, APIs, crons, and workers
Debug, seed, migration, and test routes are denied in production by an automated registry check
Production canonical, sitemap, robots, CSP, health metadata, and staging noindex checks pass
Unsubstantiated public metrics are removed or backed by approved evidence and legal-review findings are routed to an owner

evidence: Audit baseline: live production metadata, robots, sitemap, and Open Graph canonical URLs point at demo.tourify.live; staging is not isolated or noindex.
Audit baseline: live CSP includes unsafe-eval and broad sources, public claims are unsubstantiated, and route/feature gating is scattered.
